correlated_risk.summary: A direct update can land on main before CI/security/integrity results are known. Because the Railway customer-proof service is source-linked to this repository and watches deployment-sensitive paths, unprotected-main drift is also a staging provenance risk if a watched path changes.
not_claimed: No current staging mutation from this finding is claimed.
No tenant-isolation or autonomy-kernel bypass has been observed.

detection_rules.condition: source-linked staging service watches Dockerfile, DEPLOYMENT_MANIFEST.json, STAGING_FREEZE.json or artifact/** while main is unprotected

safe_runbook: Keep this repository private; do not weaken privacy to gain ruleset features.
Enable enforceable protection for main using the strongest repository control available to the account plan.
Require the repository security/integrity gates that protect the sealed candidate before merges or direct updates are accepted.
Disallow force-pushes and routine direct pushes to main; use bounded branches and pull requests.
After protection is enabled, rerun this audit and verify protected=true before changing any deployment-sensitive watched path.
Do not change Railway staging or production settings merely to make this audit green.
promotion_rule: No production or pilot promotion may rely on repository CI as a mandatory gate while main can be updated without enforceable pre-merge/pre-update protection.
